name: bawksync
description: End-to-end encrypted sync server for bawkterm, an SSH, SFTP and Remote Desktop client. It stores only data your devices encrypted, so it cannot read your hosts, passwords or keys. First start: leave Token empty and one is created for you. It is printed once in the log and saved in the data folder as "tokens". To show it again, open the container's Console and run: bawksync tokens In bawkterm, connect to http://[your Unraid IP]:8787 with that token.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Encrypted database and the tokens file.

variables.name: Token
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to have a token created on first start. Or paste your own: 32 or more random characters.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns the data folder. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns the data folder. 100 is users on Unraid.
